about_the_game:
On an unseasonal winter’s eve, fate cast before Iris—a solitary scholar of University of Benishire—the wretched figure of Salvator, a fellow disciple of music, lying prone upon the frozen earth, steeped in the ruin of drunk. There began the unraveling of her quiet life…

Host-Punk, that once-popular genre of last century, now forgotten in the shadows, is fading out of the public. Yet when Tomoko, a maiden of letters, crossed their path, the three resolved to forge the last Host-Punk band, against the dying of the light.

And so their music odyssey began—a trial of clutter and sorrow! Between the purity of their yearning and the cruel truth of the world stood walls unyielding, forcing upon them choices of the grey compromise.

What destiny awaits them, entangled as they are in tender affections newly sprung, the enigma of Sherlock, and the inexorable coils of fate? Behold, a tale where the dirge of Host-Punk crosses with the whispers of yuri love—a symphony of passion and despair!

A yuri-laden chronicle with multiple choosable branches and rich contents, recounting the ballad of Host-Punk’s forsaken daughters—the maidens of "Hypothermia."
